verdict.rationale: Raygun ships a built-in AI Error Resolution chat that is auto-prompted with stack trace, environment and code context, suggests root causes and fixes, supports collaborative chat, and can post a link to the conversation into error comments. However, it is an advisory assistant scoped to individual errors and needs the user's own OpenAI API key; there is no evidence it can be handed tasks to carry out on its own. missing for 10: evidence the assistant takes actions or completes delegated tasks (e.g. changing error status, opening PRs, applying fixes), assistant scope beyond single-error diagnosis, a built-in model that needs no user-supplied key, independent or hands-on corroboration.
